fields.description: Program Description Speak Mandarin only 24/7 in old China capital Live and eat with a Chinese homxestay family. Visit the UNESCO World heritage places. 1 on-1 classes only (no foreign class mates) Activities with locals-from football to Chinese chess and hiking clubs (Mandarin-speak only) -Flexibility- weekend or whole week program available ​-Includes return transfers between Beijing and Chengde Cheng de (not Chengdu!) was the Qing Emperors’ summer residence and the place where standard Mandarin Chinese was codified in 1952. The city is located about two hour north-east of Beijing. Here people speak most “standard” Mandarin in all of china, but not a work in English. . The city is a UNESCO World Heritage site, is located in the mountains with plenty of fresh air and has no expat community. Here you will speak Mandarin only all day and be completely immersed into a Chinese language and culture environment. Students study the first half of the program in Beijing and the second in Chengde. This is for students who are looking for the quickest language progress possible. It also offers the great experience of living in a big metropolitan city as well as a smaller more traditional town like Chengde. The total immersion environment in Chengde is especially helpful in helping students’ language skills to progress very quickly. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
